item.title: Democrat exits Senate race, leaving independent as sole challenger to GOP incumbent
item.description: Democratic Senate candidate Julian Beaudion withdrew from the South Dakota race, leaving only GOP Sen. Mike Rounds and independent challenger Brian B.

item.title: Senate confirms new CDC director amid parasite outbreak in US
item.description: Dr. Erica Schwartz was confirmed as CDC director along party lines amid concerns about her stance on vaccines and independence from Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

item.title: Tlaib bill seeks to block ICE airport arrests, citing TSA data sharing
item.description: Rashida Tlaib's legislation would prevent ICE and Border Patrol from accessing TSA passenger screening data, travel records, and data broker information.

item.title: Cassidy undecided on Todd Blanche for attorney general
item.description: Sen. Bill Cassidy, R-La., said Wednesday he has not decided whether to support Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general, saying he wants assurance.
